description: This Java class 'SavingsAccountChargeDataValidator' provides validation logic for JSON data related to savings account charges in the Apache Fineract project. It validates add, update, and pay charge operations by parsing JSON input, checking required fields, value constraints, and throwing validation exceptions if necessary.

classes.name: SavingsAccountChargeDataValidator
classes.description: Validator class for processing and validating JSON input data related to savings account charges in the Fineract banking application.

methods.name: validateAdd
methods.description: Validates JSON input for adding a new savings account charge, checking parameters like chargeId, amount, due date, and fee date.

methods.name: validateUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for updating an existing savings account charge, focusing on amount, due date, fee date, and fee interval.

methods.name: validatePayCharge
methods.description: Validates JSON input for paying a charge, ensuring amount and transaction date are provided and valid.
